input.question: Tesla Motors, Why they are so great, Why I've never heard about them before, and why everyone isn't driving this supposed amazing car?
input.ground_truth: > Tesla Motors, Why they are so great, They sell a unique product that is considered very trendy. > Why I've never heard about them before, You don't go outside much, read newspapers very often, or trade stocks. Seriously, the name Tesla is everywhere on reddit, even. They are a young company though, so that might be part of the issue. > and why everyone isn't driving this supposed amazing car? Brand new high tech cars aren't cheap. You'd be lucky to pay less than 60 grand for even the most basic model. Also, many people have concerns about the battery range and recharging safety/convenience.

Question: Tesla Motors, Why they are so great, Why I've never heard about them before, and why everyone isn't driving this supposed amazing car?

response.prediction:
Okay, let’s imagine Tesla is like a really cool, super-fast toy car that not everyone has yet.

**Why are Tesla cars so great?**  
Because they can go zoom-zoom really fast without making a lot of loud noise, and they don’t need gas! They run on electricity, kind of like how your tablet charges up. They also have a big screen inside, like a giant tablet, and can even drive by themselves a little bit.

**Why haven’t you heard about them before?**  
Maybe you haven’t heard much because Tesla cars are newer and a bit more expensive, like how some kids have the newest video game and others don’t. Also, not everyone can buy one yet because they cost a lot of money.

**Why aren’t *everyone* driving them?**  
Well, think about how not everyone has a big fancy bike or the newest sneakers. Tesla cars are still pretty new, and they’re a bit pricey. Also, there aren’t enough places to charge them everywhere, like how you can’t get ice cream at every store. Plus, some people are used to the old kind of cars and need time to learn about the new ones.

So, Tesla cars are super cool and special, but it takes time for everyone to have one!
